items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Bobby Carroll left to go with Lucky Millinder; Interviewee does not claim personal interaction with Millinder.

ctx.x: Yeah. She did. I remember that.
So it was Stovall and Courtney; Bob Carroll left you to go with Lucky Millinder at one point, around 1940; that's why he's not on the first record.
No, no, no. Bobby Carroll's on the first record.
